why: ChatGPT says these turntables send Bluetooth audio out and you'll need a separate speaker, but it then asks whether the shopper will use Bluetooth speakers or headphones they may already own, so the purchase is one turntable (AT-LP70XBT vs Sony PS-LX3BT vs JBL Spinner BT). No sizing or compatibility fact can make the pair fail: any Bluetooth speaker or headphone pairs with a Bluetooth-out turntable, and a codec mismatch (aptX vs SBC) only falls back to SBC, so a researched kit adds nothing a shopper could get wrong.
